failure_classifier: unit test PASS; historical four-failure report recognized
diagnosis: EWMH activation and background DOM activeElement were insufficient: document.hasFocus was false and a physical q did not arrive. Resolving the human handle before handoff, then switching WebDriver to it and clicking its input established hasFocus=true and physical q. Enumerating windows after handoff activated the leased tab and correctly paused ownership; avoid that during concurrency. Private-display XTest keystrokes overlapped MCP actions, with no refocusing during overlap.
